heroTitle: A Moroccan Cosmetic Factory Built for Professional Buyers
heroIntro: Morocco Cosmetic is a producer of Moroccan cosmetic products based in Marrakech. We press argan oil and make black soap, and we fill, label and ship a full range of Moroccan cosmetic products for distributors, spas and brands around the world.
heroLinksSuffix: pages for catalog details and how we work with buyers.
visualBlurb: Production and packing for wholesale, spas, and OEM partners.
photoExportAlt: Pallet of sealed white cartons strapped for export
photoBulkAlt: Bulk one-kilogram jars and litre argan oil on the production bench
photoPackingAlt: Sealed shipping carton next to filled dropper bottles at the packing table
photoWorkshopAlt: Argan oil bottles and bulk beldi soap prepared for packing in our Marrakech workshop
hubIllustrationAria: Marrakech production and export hub connected to the argan region in the southwest, the Atlas Mountains, and the rose valleys in the southeast.
locationBody: Marrakech sits between the regions our main ingredients come from: the argan area of the southwest, the Atlas Mountains where ghassoul clay is mined, and the rose-growing valleys to the south-east. It is also a well-connected export hub, which keeps lead times short for sea and air freight.

visitBody: We welcome visits by appointment and can arrange a live video tour of the facility.
faqManufacturerQ: Are you a manufacturer or a trader?
faqManufacturerA: Both, and we are transparent about it. We press argan oil and make black soap in our Marrakech facility. Our other products come from selected Moroccan producers; we fill, label, check and ship them from our facility.
faqVisitA: Yes, by appointment. We can also organize a video call inside the facility.
